checks.name: phase-d-sources-exist
command: set -euo pipefail; for f in Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.h Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.cpp Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp CMakeLists.txt; do test -f "$f"; done

checks.name: editor-wires-reroll-and-meters
command: set -euo pipefail; grep -E 'reRollMasterSeed|reRoll|reroll' Source/PluginEditor.cpp; grep -q 'DriftDisplay' Source/PluginEditor.h Source/PluginEditor.cpp; grep -q 'GoniometerComponent' Source/PluginEditor.h; grep -q 'CorrelationMeter' Source/PluginEditor.h; grep -E 'timerCallback|startTimerHz|startTimer' Source/PluginEditor.cpp

checks.name: driftdisplay-hides-v3-v4
command: set -euo pipefail; grep -E 'voiceCount|setVoiceCount|setActiveVoices|activeVoices|numVoices' Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.h Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp

checks.name: build-phase-d
command: set -euo pipefail; find_cmake(){ if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v cmake; return; fi; shopt -s nullglob; cands=("$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake "$HOME"/.local/share/JetBrains/Toolbox/apps/clion/*/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /opt/clion/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake /snap/clion/current/bin/cmake/linux/x64/bin/cmake); shopt -u nullglob; for c in "${cands[@]}"; do if [[ -x "$c" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$c"; return; fi; done; return 1; }; if [[ -x scripts/build_all.sh ]]; then bash scripts/build_all.sh; else CMAKE_BIN="$(find_cmake)"; "$CMAKE_BIN" -S . -B build/linux-relwithdebinfo -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo; "$CMAKE_BIN" --build build/linux-relwithdebinfo --config RelWithDebInfo --parallel; fi
